signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAT2C( UPLO, N, A, LDA, SA, LDSA, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of rows and columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-N triangular coefficient matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: SA
params.reference: Only the `UPLO` part of `SA` is referenced. On exit, if `INFO=0`, the N-by-N coefficient matrix `SA`; if $\mathrm{INFO}>0$, the content of the `UPLO` part of `SA` is unspecified.

params.name: ldsa
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `SA`. $\mathrm{LDSA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `= 1`: an entry of the matrix A is greater than the SINGLE PRECISION overflow threshold, in this case, the content of the `UPLO` part of `SA` in exit is unspecified.
